question.text: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in Ch 1.6 as an international standard relevant to social development reporting?

answer.text: UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 1.6 on p25, the international standards listed are: OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, UN Global Compact, Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and Global Reporting Initiative (GRI). ISO 31000 is a risk-management standard — not listed in Ch 1.6. The Trap: Options A, B and C are verbatim from Ch 1.6. Option D (ISO 31000) is a real standard but not mentioned in this chapter — the trap for candidates who 'over-recognise' standards. Note: When citing standards in the AIR, stick to the chapter's stated framework list on p25.
